notes.title: Summer Content Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings to all of you![/h1]

We just updated our game with some new content for you all to enjoy for FREE for you who own the game already! 
All who buy the game after this patch will of course have this content unlocked as well.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27886740/619da028a6a314714e005205caddc133326fa2fd.png[/img]
The new content is:

[*]The all new beach theme
[*]Teamplay with special skins and gear
[*]A brand new gamemode - Nootball 
[*]The ability to taunt your foes

We hope you like our game and are having a great time playing the new gamemode. We sure had a blast making it!

Take care

/Babloonians
Post by ChrisoperRobi
